a.lede: The U.S. government is helping fund projects to bring nuclear reactors back online in an attempt to provide more energy capacity to AI data centers.
a.title: US restarts three shut-down nuclear reactors to feed AI data centers

b.lede: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.
b.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
